custom_preconds:
ShopPay feature enabled on the org AND a workplace with a terminal reader configured (has_terminal_readers). If absent, the test self-annotates/skips the terminal comparison.
An invoiced, unpaid Work Order with a contact exists (seeded via API).
Two confirmed custom-role users provisioned via API:
- Control: Invoicing & Payments Create&Edit, See Financial ON, Customer Portal page-access ON.
- Leak: Invoicing & Payments Create&Edit, See Financial ON, Customer Portal page-access OFF.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the Control user; open the WO Finance tab and click New Payment
custom_steps_separated.expected: The payment dialog opens (title_new_payment) and button_send_to_terminal is visible (both required atoms present). If not visible, terminal infra is absent -> annotate/skip remaining terminal steps.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the Leak user; open the same WO Finance tab
custom_steps_separated.expected: button_new_payment is present (Create&Edit grants payment entry, so the dialog is reachable).

custom_steps_separated.content: As the Leak user, click New Payment to open the dialog
custom_steps_separated.expected: button_send_to_terminal is NOT present, because Customer Portal is OFF (SV-8087 gate).

title: Send to Terminal requires Invoicing Create&Edit AND Customer Portal ON (SV-8087 leak guard)
